CIDR Notation
192.168.1.0/24 - **SUBNET**

Tab's IP: 192.168.1.4
Binary: 11000000.10101000.00000001.00000100

Mobile's IP: 192.168.1.2
Binary: 11000000.10101000.00000001.00000010

**SUBNET_MASK**
IP: 255.255.255.0
Binary: 11111111.11111111.11111111.00000000

Send data from _Mobile_ to _Tab_

**Bitwise & Operation**

_Tab_
11000000.10101000.00000001.00000100
& 11111111.11111111.11111111.00000000
--------.--------.--------.--------
= 11000000.10101000.00000001.00000000
IP: 192.168.1.0

_Mobile_
11000000.10101000.00000001.00000010
& 11111111.11111111.11111111.00000000
--------.--------.--------.--------
= 11000000.10101000.00000001.00000000
IP: 192.168.1.0

Now we can check both SUBNET_MASK IP same, mean both are on same NETOWRK

#### Outside of network

Mobile's IP: 10.0.0.2
Binary: 00001010.00000000.00000000.00000010

**Bitwise & Operation**

_Tab_
11000000.10101000.00000001.00000100
& 11111111.11111111.11111111.00000000
--------.--------.--------.--------
= 11000000.10101000.00000001.00000000
IP: 192.168.1.0

_Mobile_
00001010.00000000.00000000.00000010
& 11111111.11111111.11111111.00000000
--------.--------.--------.--------
= 00001010.00000000.00000000.00000000
IP: 110.0.0.0

Both IP are not same which mean HOSTs are not in the same NETWORK
